notes: The cell is in the pair notation for INS-pairs, which is not built yet; leaky_field.py states the cell's view, release and pair in Z3, and the cell is committed verbatim beside it. The viewer's replay is not part of this run.

The encoding relates only what the cell's release names (title and body of a shared document) and dana's read right; owner_team, which the cell's page also shows, is left unreleased, so with internal_notes dropped the general query still finds a pair that differs in owner_team. The lesson pair (only internal_notes differs) is unsat once internal_notes leaves the page.

Recorded with the bench image built from bench/image/Dockerfile (a local build; the digest is its manifest list's, never pushed). Each configuration ran once, in a fresh container with the run's cells mounted read-only at /w; <sandbox>/work stands for the scratch copy of runs/RUN-z3-leaky-field/cells/.
Every verdict line is copied from the logs; values.configs.<config>.lines is parsed from those lines by label (slugged), and the other values are read from that parse, never typed.
Recorded for the W1 report's follow-up 1 (task_label: W1-followup-1). run@1's task field must match W<n>-S<nn> or W<n>-T<nn>, which that name does not, so the record leaves task out.
Z3's model values are not canonical: a witness is checked by its property, never matched by value.

Re-executed on 2026-10-27 with scripts/runs/rerun-argv.mjs, from the same argv and the same staged inputs; every log matched the earlier recording byte for byte; 2 verdict line(s) the recorder had added ("== <config>: <command>", "-- exit N"), which the tool never prints and no log holds, were dropped, so every verdict line is now a line of a log.
